valuation_template_rationale: Canadian Solar combines cyclical module manufacturing, storage systems, non-recourse project assets, minority interests and complex financing; a conservative attributable-book NAV captures debt, dilution and realization discounts more directly than a pure compounder or commodity template.
bear_assumptions: About 0.25x March 2026 attributable book value as module oversupply, weak normalized margins, inventory cash use, refinancing pressure and project-sale delays deepen the asset-value discount.
base_assumptions: About 0.45x March 2026 attributable book value as storage growth and project sales partly offset module weakness, high debt, minority interests and cash-flow volatility.
bull_assumptions: About 0.65x March 2026 attributable book value as storage scales profitably, localized manufacturing improves mix, working capital releases, project monetization succeeds and debt declines.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh results confirm normalized profitability and positive free cash flow while the mark clears the required margin of safety and both downside-payoff gates; downgrade if storage growth slows, gross margin misses guidance, module losses persist, inventories or debt rise, project sales slip, liquidity tightens or dilution materially increases.
